diagnosis.root_cause: The live Caddy configuration in shop-proxy was loaded from /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.misroute and proxies to shop-web:8001, but shop-web listens on port 8000. The on-disk /etc/caddy/Caddyfile has the correct upstream shop-web:8000, so the mismatch is a proxy configuration error.

evidence.detail: Live shop-proxy config sends traffic to shop-web:8001; its on-disk /etc/caddy/Caddyfile points to shop-web:8000.
shop-proxy logged refused connections to 172.23.0.4:8001 and returned 502 for /health and /api/items.
shop-web reports Uvicorn listening on 0.0.0.0:8000 and successful health checks.

proposal.reason: Reload the on-disk Caddyfile, which routes to shop-web:8000, replacing the misrouted live configuration. This directly addresses the diagnosed proxy configuration error without restarting the database or other services.

proposal.reason: The live Caddy configuration is misrouted, while the on-disk Caddyfile already points to shop-web:8000. Reload that file into the running proxy to correct the upstream without restarting other containers.
